title: Kerobokan Prison

terrainReference.basis: Original ground at the street-facing reception forecourt.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap institution and the directly adjoining mapped public frontage.
mapIdentity.scope: The site’s named north street frontage fixes the extent and orientation. The building footprint inside this frontage is estimated from the public photograph.

note: Davidelit’s original CC0 photograph shows the cream fascias, broad low canopy, recessed shaded public windows, brick-red base trim, maroon hipped roofs and raised Lapas Denpasar name.
